question: Aanya has to reach Bangalore which is 861 km away in 15 hours. His starting speed for 8 hours was 37 km/hr. For the next 136 km his speed was 34 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Bangalore in the decided time of 15 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 861 km, Total time = 15 hours.

Distance covered in the first 8 hours = 8 × 37 = 296 km.

Time taken to cover the next 136 km = 136 ÷ 34 = 4 hours.

Remaining distance = 861 − (296 + 136) = 429 km.

Remaining time = 15 − (8 + 4) = 3 hours.

Required speed = 429 ÷ 3 = 143 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 143 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance to Bangalore = 861 km

Total scheduled time = 15 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Distance = Speed × Time
